spanish: ¿Y por qué disuadirán el corazón de hijos de Israel de pasar a la tierra que dio a ellos Jehová?

findings.issue: disuadirán is an unmarked finite verb (future, 3rd plural) with no licensing token; after וְלָמָּה the clause has only the object marker, לֵב, and the qal infinitive מֵעֲבֹר

notes: Question, heart of sons of Israel, from passing to the land that he gave to them, and Jehová match the tokens.
